title: McediaGUI
description: A GUI interface plugin for server-side integration with Mcedia MOD.
body:
# McediaGUI

中文说明：https://github.com/Cherry7593/McediaGUI

A Minecraft video player plugin that supports **Bilibili**, **Douyin**, and **direct video links**.

---

## 📌 Usage

- `/mcedia create <name>` — Create a video player
- **Sneak + Right-click with empty hand** — Open the editor GUI
- Set the video URL and adjust parameters

---

## 🎛 Editor GUI

### 🎥 Video Input
- Set video URL

### 🖥 Display Settings
- Scale
- Position offset

### 🔊 Audio Settings
- Volume
- Hearing range

### 🏷 Tag Settings
- Loop (Left Click)
- Danmaku / Bullet Comments (Right Click)

### 📑 Template
- Save / Apply configuration templates  
- Up to **7 templates** supported

---

## ⌨ Commands

| Command | Permission |
|------|-----------|
| `/mcedia create <name>` | `mcedia.create` |
| `/mcedia list` | `mcedia.admin` |
| `/mcedia delete <name>` | `mcedia.delete` |
| `/mcedia gui` | `mcedia.admin` |
| `/mcedia reload` | `mcedia.reload` |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

- `mcedia.use` — Sneak + right-click to edit (default: everyone)
- `mcedia.admin` — Admin functions (default: OP)
- `mcedia.create` / `mcedia.delete` / `mcedia.reload` (default: OP)

---

## 🌐 Supported Platforms

- **Bilibili** (videos / livestreams / bangumi)
- **Douyin**
- **Sakura Anime**
- **Direct video links**

---

## ⚙ Configuration

plugins/McediaGUI/config.yml

- **Paper 1.20.4+ / Folia**
